sections.heading: Summary
sections.content: ConvertHub processes all files directly in your browser. We never send your files to our servers. Your privacy is our top priority.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.content: We only collect essential data for service operation. We do not collect file content.

sections.heading: How we process files
sections.content: All files are processed 100% client-side using the browser's Canvas API. Files never leave your device.

sections.heading: Ads
sections.content: Free users see static banners. We do not use advertising tracking or share data with third parties.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.content: Payments are processed by PayPal. We do not store credit card information.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.content: You can request data deletion at any time. Contact us at privacy@converthub.com.
